submission.justification: Among all evaluated configurations, Mixture-G3 with a 2.5 mm gas gap provides the best time resolution of 0.908 ns, which surpasses all other mixture/gap combinations tested. This directly achieves the primary project goal of optimizing time resolution. The chosen gap (2.5 mm) is within the allowed range (1-3 mm), and Mixture-G3 is a listed candidate mixture, ensuring compliance with project constraints. Environmental and safety compliance are assumed based on candidate pre-selection and standard laboratory systems for these gas mixtures.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution.
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G3 at 2.5 mm gives the lowest (best) time resolution (0.908 ns) among all options.

requirements.requirement: The mixture must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G3 is one of the three candidates.

requirements.requirement: The gas system must comply with the laboratory's environmental and safety policies.
requirements.evidence: All candidate mixtures are presumed compliant per project documentation and candidate specification.
Selected gap is 2.5 mm, within the specified range.
